scripts.initialize:
set -euo pipefail
source /usr/local/share/nvm/nvm.sh
nvm install 22.23.3
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
for binary in node npm npx; do
  ln -sfn "$(dirname "$(nvm which 22.23.3)")/$binary" "$HOME/.local/bin/$binary"
done
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
{
  node --version
  npm --version
  for file in package.json package-lock.json npm-shrinkwrap.json .npmrc .nvmrc .node-version; do
    if [ -f "$file" ]; then sha256sum "$file"; fi
  done
} | sha256sum > "$(git rev-parse --git-path capy-install-inputs.sha256)"
scripts.refresh:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
if [ "$(node --version)" != v22.23.3 ]; then
  source /usr/local/share/nvm/nvm.sh
  nvm install 22.23.3
  mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
  for binary in node npm npx; do
    ln -sfn "$(dirname "$(nvm which 22.23.3)")/$binary" "$HOME/.local/bin/$binary"
  done
fi
stamp="$(git rev-parse --git-path capy-install-inputs.sha256)"
inputs="$({
  node --version
  npm --version
  for file in package.json package-lock.json npm-shrinkwrap.json .npmrc .nvmrc .node-version; do
    if [ -f "$file" ]; then sha256sum "$file"; fi
  done
} | sha256sum)"
if [ ! -d node_modules ] || [ ! -f "$stamp" ] || [ "$(cat "$stamp")" != "$inputs" ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
  printf '%s\n' "$inputs" > "$stamp"
fi
